significance: A Digambara Jain temple at Sanganer near Jaipur dedicated to Rishabhanatha, whose last building phase an inscription of V.S. 1011 places in the 10th century; it is among the older Jain shrines of the Jaipur region.
story: It is told that when thirty-nine Jain images were recovered from the temple after Muni Sudhasagar's visit in 1999, yakshas in the form of snakes were found guarding the hoard.
